title: Bongo Planet — classic video game themes

tracks.title: Super Mario Bros. — Ground Theme
tracks.description: The seven-note opening fanfare on bright marimba, keeping its little silences and high-to-low G answer. Plucked bass, kalimba and a light backbeat give it a bouncy planet groove.

tracks.title: The Legend of Zelda — Overworld
tracks.description: The main-theme leap from B-flat down to F, then the quick climb into a high F. That last note is held to close this two-bar adaptation, over piano roots, glass and soft hand percussion.

tracks.title: Tetris — Type A (Korobeiniki)
tracks.description: All 92 nodes join one 91-hop journey: the complete eight-bar main tune, a compact natural-minor bridge and a closing cadence. Piano leads, with low guitar, marimba and hand-drum answers in the held notes. The 75 BPM grid gives the main tune its familiar 150 BPM feel; the 24-beat loop lasts 19.2 seconds.

tracks.title: Final Fantasy — Prelude
tracks.description: The signature C–D–E–G added-ninth arpeggio rises from C2 to C6 and falls back toward home. Glass takes the flowing line, with quiet piano, low guitar and a barely-there hand-drum pulse.
